Prifddinas (IPAc-en | p | r | ɪ | v | ˈ | θ | iː | n | ə | s Respell-en | priv | THEE | nuss ) is the greatest city of the elves and the capital city of Tirannwn. It is located just north of Isafdar. The city is the oldest surviving settlement on Gielinor, being created in the First Age, when it was made almost entirely of wood with small amounts of crystal. It has since been reshaped and is now composed entirely from crystals by Seren and Tarddiad. Due to the Elven Civil War, the entire city was reverted to crystal seed form, but it is reformed during the Plague's End quest. As such, Plague's End is a requirement to visit the city.

The Wizards' Tower is a famous Saradominist institute of magic and runecrafting in Misthalin. The immense tower is located on a small island south of Draynor Village, connected to the mainland by an exquisite bridge.  The tower is associated with many other wizards outside the tower as well as the Wizards' Guild of Yanille, with which it has a sort of rivalry. The Wizards' Tower has two of the only known portals to the Runespan realm, home of the Runecrafting Guild. The current Wizards' Tower is sometimes known as the Second Wizards' Tower, as the First Wizards' Tower was burnt to the ground due to a magical explosion in the year 70 of the Fifth Age.

ml.text: Caitlin was once a student of the Wizards' Tower herself. She shared a room with Ariane, a seer trainee with the power of precognition. Caitlin spread this around the other students, and they all shunned Ariane, believing she was using her powers to cheat. Caitlin discovered Dragith Nurn's notes in the ruins of the old tower and worked with Reese, then an acolyte at the Lumbridge church, to find Dragith's secrets.

There are several methods of reaching the Crafting Guild. In addition to walking to the guild, players may use the following transportation methods:
A skills necklace or modified artisan's bandana can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
Teleporting to the Port Sarim lodestone and running north-west.
Teleporting to the Rimmington player-owned house portal.
Members who have unlocked the Crafting Guild hot air balloon route after completing Enlightened Journey can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of two charges.
While the guild itself does not stock sheep, there is a handy flock wandering free immediately to the north, just outside the Makeover Mage's house.

All players can use the bank deposit box in the guild itself. This turns into a bank chest upon the completion of the hard Falador achievements. Players retain access to the bank chest even after their membership expires.

The farm is in some ways the crossroads of Asgarnia. It has a convenient location, near Draynor Village, Falador, Port Sarim, and Rimmington. There are several ways to reach the farm.
The fastest way is to utilise the Cabbageport function of the Explorer's ring 3 or 4, as this will teleport the user to the cabbage patch belonging to the farm.
If players have their house in Rimmington, they can teleport to house and run to the farm.
If players have a spirit tree grown in Port Sarim, they can teleport there and run north.
Using the Captain's Log to teleport to Port Sarim and go north.
Teleport to the Port Sarim lodestone and run north, or the Draynor lodestone then run west.
If a player binds their amulet of nature to a patch in the farm, it will teleport the player to the patch when the crops are diseased or fully grown. As this isn't certain, it is rarely used.
Players can charter a ship to Port Sarim and run north.
Falador farm

place.title: Falador farm
place.summary: If that isn't enough, there is also a large pasture containing several cows, which will all drop raw beef, bones, and their prized cowhides. The meat can be cooked in Falador or on a fire to be used as food, the bones buried, and the cowhides tanned and used for Crafting, or sold on the Grand Exchange to others wishing to train Crafting for a fair price. If players don't wish to cook the meat for food, they can also eat the cabbages that spawn in the patch nearby.

The single most popular General Store on the planet.
pic: The single most popular General Store on the planet.

get_inside.text: To enter Lumbridge, players can use the bridge to the east of the town over the River Lum.
From the south, there is a path from Lumbridge Swamp that players can use to enter the town.
From the north, players can cross the bridge leading out from the west of the Champions' Guild and through the Mill Road Mill, heading east along the road.
Players can also, from the west, enter the town through the path leading from Draynor Village passing by the pale wisp colony.
Lumbridge lodestone
pic: The Lumbridge musician entertaining near the River Lum.

get_inside.text: Lumbridge Teleport - Unlike the lodestone, this requires level 31 Magic, a law rune, an earth rune, and three air runes but is faster and does not get interrupted by combat. Casting this spell is a medium Lumbridge achievement, Ease of Access.

Lumbridge teleport tablet - Members have the additional option of using teleport tablets to reach Lumbridge. This works similar to casting the Lumbridge Teleport spell normally but can be used when any spellbook is active and only takes up one inventory space.
Ring of respawn - Can teleport the player to the Lumbridge Castle courtyard.
Canoe - Provided the player has the Woodcutting level required, they may use the system to reach several locations, including Lumbridge.
A boat may be taken from the docks south of Taverley, which places players next to the Lumbridge Sage.

Portal Chamber - Players with at least level 50 Construction can build a Lumbridge Teleportation Portal in the Portal Chamber of their player-owned house. Building the portal requires 100 law runes, 300 air runes, and 100 earth runes.

Death - A method that requires little to no effort and no requirements, dying can send the player back to Lumbridge if they have not selected a different respawn point. Since Lumbridge is unlocked by default, this provides a way to get there with no skills or quests required. Players are, however, strongly recommended to bank any valuable items as they will only keep three (four with Protect item prayer on) items in case they do not reach their gravestone in time.
Lumbridge

pics: The single most popular General Store on the planet.

place.title: Lumbridge
place.summary: It is the first town that new players enter after completing the tutorial, and is home to various low level activities and quests. On the west side of the river the town has a general store, a fishing shop, a market with a bank and Thieving stalls as well as a smithy with a forge and an anvil and an entrance to the Thieves' Guild. The east side primarily features a large cow pen. The river itself has several Fishing spots. The southern part of the town houses a church with a graveyard and an entrance to the Lumbridge Catacombs and a passage to the Lumbridge Swamp. The city of Dorgesh-Kaan can be accessed from the castle's basement. West of the castle lies the Lumbridge forest.

get_inside.text: The main entrance to the caves is through the Lumbridge Swamp, located south of Lumbridge. It is located in the centre of the swamp with a icon on the minimap. A rope is required when using this entrance for the first time. The Water altar is near this entrance.

Another route is through the basement of Lumbridge Castle, as the tunnels between the castle and the Dorgesh-Kaan mine also deviate towards the Swamp Caves, directly south from the tunnel entrance in the castle basement. The route between the tunnels and the Swamp Caves is initially blocked and needs to be mined. The Lost Tribe is required to access the tunnels and thus access the Swamp Caves from this direction.
A final route is via teleporting to the Tears of Guthix cavern with a games necklace then heading north.

get_inside.text: Pollnivneach
Monstrous cave crawler, level 96
Using a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll is the fastest way to get there, as it puts the player very close to the entrance of the dungeon.
Using a ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona, although this requires completion of Smoking Kills. (Players with the Slayer cape can also use its perk to teleport to Sumona.)
Use the Desert amulet 2 or higher to teleport to Nardah, then take the magic carpet to Pollnivneach.
If a player's house is in Pollnivneach, they can teleport to their house. If the player has completed Love Story, a Pollnivneach tablet can be used regardless of the player's house location.
Using the magic carpets, players can pay a fee (or ride freely using the ring of charos) to Pollnivneach.
From the Bandit Camp's lodestone, walk east to Pollnivneach, or take the shortcut in the Smoke Dungeon.

Alternatively, movement abilities like Surge can be used to bypass the wall beasts.

getting_there.heading: Getting to the caves
getting_there.text:
The main entrance to the caves is through the Lumbridge Swamp, located south of Lumbridge. It is located in the centre of the swamp with a icon on the minimap. A rope is required when using this entrance for the first time. The Water altar is near this entrance.

Another route is through the basement of Lumbridge Castle, as the tunnels between the castle and the Dorgesh-Kaan mine also deviate towards the Swamp Caves, directly south from the tunnel entrance in the castle basement. The route between the tunnels and the Swamp Caves is initially blocked and needs to be mined. The Lost Tribe is required to access the tunnels and thus access the Swamp Caves from this direction.

A final route is via teleporting to the Tears of Guthix cavern with a games necklace then heading north.

ml.text: A cave slime is a Slayer monster found on all of Daemonheim's floors. They require level 17 Slayer to kill. They are the only monsters that can drop the special Incantor's boots and Sorcerer's boots. Unlike the cave slime found in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves and Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon, these monsters are not poisonous.

place.title: The Zamorakian Undercity
place.summary: While it is considered an Elite Dungeon (with its own luck charms and ability to teleport to the other Elite Dungeons) it is noticeably different compared to the previous three; the health of enemies scales to the party size (and are also more dangerous) and its luck charm costs slightly more and cannot be converted. It also possesses an enrage system that goes up in intervals of 100% past 4,000% enrage, and the enemies' strengths, types, and quantities begin to change as it increases, capping at 60,000%. Players are free to choose their enrage from 0 to 4,000%. Clearing the undercity increases the rewards obtained from Zamorak.

get_inside.text: Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

get_inside.text: Players must go to the Yanille area to reach the dungeon. Other than walking, there are a few ways to get there:
The Watchtower Teleport to the Watchtower, which is quite close to the dungeon's northern entrance. This teleport ability is a reward of the Watchtower quest.
The House Teleport to Yanille, if the player has a house and has located it in Yanille.
The Ring of duelling teleport to Castle Wars, which is west of Yanille.
Fairy ring code CIQ, which arrives north-west of Yanille. Partial completion of the quest A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen is required to use the fairy rings.
Teleport using the Ardougne Cape 1 to the Monastery to the north of Yanille.
Teleport using the Home teleport to the Yanille Lodestone to the west of Yanille.
Modifying a Teleport to House tablet, so it will let you teleport to the Yanille House Portal.
The dungeon has two entrances:

The northern entrance is a small house north of the Yanille city walls. It is very close to the shortcut under the wall by the farming patch. Spider webs block the entrance to the house. Players must cut through a web before they can enter the house using a knife from their tool belt.

The southern entrance is a house in south-east Yanille, west of the smithy with the anvils. Players can access this house and its basement, but the door connecting the basement to the rest of the dungeon is locked. To pick the lock and open the door, players must have a lockpick in their inventory and must have a Thieving level of at least 82.
Yanille Agility dungeon

place.summary: The experience rewards for using this dungeon are not as good as most other Agility courses, so players rarely come here to train Agility. Instead, players use it to training combat skills using the monsters there and gather their drops. Players training Herblore also use the dungeon, since many monsters here sometimes drop high-level herbs. Torstol, a fairly rare herb, can be obtained here.

place.title: Yanille Agility dungeon

Instead, players use it to training combat skills using the monsters there and gather their drops. • The House Teleport to Yanille, if the player has a house and has located it in Yanille.
• The Ring of duelling teleport to Castle Wars, which is west of Yanille.

start_overview: Location of the Taverley Dungeon — Taverley

get_inside.text: Taverley
The entrance to the caverns

The entrance to the dungeon is found south of Taverley and west of Falador. After the update UD | Troll Warzone , it was relocated closer to a bank - directly south of the dock past the bridge by the wheat patch. (The boat carries to Daemonheim, and from there to Al Kharid or back to Taverley).

The Obelisk of Water on an island can only be reached by traversing the dungeon. The island is just off the coast near Catherby. There is a one-way mithril grapple shortcut from the island to the shore which requires 36 Agility, 39 Ranged, and 22 Strength.
Taverley Dungeon

get_inside.text: Cleanup | The following methods all refer to the same boatman/ferryman; please restate them concisely.

Start at the Grand Exchange, go north-west and travel to Keldagrim through the Keldagrim trapdoor. Then run north until seeing a bridge. Cross it and go south past the Kelda hops patch in front of the Consortium's western entrance until getting to the Stonemason's hut, then go east until reaching a small tower-like building. Open the door, go through, and follow the southern path and cross the bridge. Once over the bridge, run west until seeing a tunnel (completion of Forgiveness of a Chaos Dwarf is needed). Enter the tunnel and arrive at the battlefield with level 48-92 enemies. The chaos dwarves will only become aggressive if you initiate combat against one of them, excluding the non-aggressive dwogres.

Using the Grand Exchange method listed above, one can also take a shortcut by utilising the palace that gaps the river. Simply enter the palace, go up the stairs, run over the river, go down the stairs, then leave the palace. This shortens the walk/run by about 30 seconds to a minute.

Using the Grand Exchange method there is actually a shorter way than the above method. When arriving from the Grand Exchange by cart, run to the north just past the consortium until you see a boat and a man standing next to it aptly called "Boatman" click on him and allow him to take you to the mines. Once you arrive where he takes you right click a nearby dwarf named "Ferryman" and choose the cross river option. This will put you right by the entrance to the Chaos Battlefield.

A quicker method to the battlefield is to teleport to Rellekka with an enchanted lyre or using teleport to home if your house is in Rellekka, then running northeast to the entrance to Keldagrim. Upon entering use the Dwarven Boatman and then right-clicking the Dwarven Ferryman and selecting "Cross-river." From there you can run west to the tunnel. This allows you to get back to your grave before 5 minutes have passed.

Access fairy ring DKS and run down the hill to the Keldagrim entrance. Enter Keldagrim after which you right-click the Dwarven Ferryman and select "Cross-river". From there you can run north and west to the tunnel entrance to the Chaos Dwarf Battlefield.

Another method similar to the above involves using an Ardougne cloak to teleport to the Kandarin Monastery to recharge your prayer, and either using a slayer ring to teleport to the Rellekka Slayer cave, or running to the fairy ring by the Tower of Life.

One of the fastest methods to get there is to cast the Home Teleport spell to the Fremennik Province lodestone, then running north-east to the Keldagrim entrance. Go through the entrance, through the crack in the wall, cross the river, and make your way over to the secret door which leads to the battlefield.

start_here.entrance_name: Entrance to The Heart of Gielinor

start_overview: Entrance to The Heart of Gielinor — Kharidian Desert

get_inside.text: Kharidian Desert
The entrance area of The Heart
pic: The entrance area of The Heart

get_inside.text: Using The Heart teleport, which can be made on a mahogany eagle lectern or obtained on the Grand Exchange, is the fastest way to get there. This requires completion of the Tales of the God Wars miniquest to use the teleport tablet.
Using The Heart of Gielinor teleport option on a portal nexus in a player-owned house.
Using Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) to arrive just outside one of the four faction boss chambers or attune the portal to Telos to arrive in the centre.

The Desert amulet 2 or above has unlimited teleports to Nardah, from which players can walk west to reach the Heart. This also places the player closer to Nardah's bank, and the altar (which heals to above maximum health and restores prayer) that can be accessed after completing the Spirits of the Elid quest.
Teleport via fairy ring to north of Nardah (code DLQ), then walk south and a little west.
Ride the magic carpet to Nardah, then walk west.
Home Teleport to Al Kharid or use the broomstick teleport to the Sorceress's Garden and run south to the Shantay Pass rug merchant.
Teleport to the house portal in Pollnivneach with House Teleport, a Pollnivneach Teleport scroll, or a Pollnivneach tablet and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Use the Slayer cape or a Ring of slaying to teleport to Sumona and use the North Pollnivneach rug merchant.
Teleport to the Bandit Camp lodestone and walk south-east, go over a bridge and walk a bit further east.
Teleport to the Agility Pyramid via the Jaleustrophos option on a Pharaoh's sceptre and head north.
The representatives for each faction can be found in the entrance area of The Heart. These are:
Gregorovic's Chosen, representative for Sliske
Helwyr's Chosen, representative for Seren
Furies' Chosen, representative for Zamorak
Vindicta's Chosen, representative for Zaros
Players can check their reputation with each faction at each of the representatives, as well as reclaim any reputation rewards.

Feng, the Bounty Master is also found in the entrance area. Players can be assigned one bounty a day in a faction to earn reputation. Each bounty requires 100 kills in the assigned faction, with killing the faction's General counting as 25 kills.

Players cannot use their Ingression fragments to summon their monsters at the entrance; this is because the four factions have made a truce in this area as they did not want to be "savages" and wanted to recruit mercenaries at their side.
Soothsayer Sybil is also found in the entrance area, standing next to the entrance to Telos, the Warden's lair. Players can collect loot from her as well as reset Telos's enrage.

ml.name: The Zamorakian Undercity
ml.text: Chaos witches are monsters found in The Zamorakian Undercity.

get_inside.text: Imp scavenger, level 126
The entrance to the dungeon is located east of the pulley, which is used to enter Senntisten behind the Ancient door just north of the Archaeology Guild.
Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
Use the Pontifex Shadow Ring, restored after the City of Senntisten quest, to teleport to Senntisten, run north to the Pulley.

Use the Archaeology journal to teleport to the Archaeology Guild, then walk north to the ancient door (dungeon), east to the ancient doors (The Empty Throne Room) or north-east to a winch (Senntisten Temple).
Using a gnome glider to fly to Lemanto Andra (Key press | 3 ) leaves the player very close to the ancient door.

The dig sites map in the Archaeology Guild, archaeology teleport or the master archaeologist's outfit can be used to teleport to the Senntisten Dig Site camp just north-east of the cathedral, provided the player has level 60 Archaeology or access to those items.
Dig site pendant can be used to teleport to the following:
Varrock Dig Site - Archaeologist's workbench & Bank chest, walk north-west to the ancient door.
Senntisten Temple - north-west winch entrance to temple.
Skeletal horror Teleport or invitation box can be used to teleport to the north-east of the ancient door.
Teleport to Earth altar, or using Fort Forinthry Teleport to the north-west of the ancient door.

get_inside.text: Wilderness
The fastest way to access the crater is using the Wilderness Crater lodestone.
Take a canoe to the Wilderness pond then run south and use one of the northern entrances to the crater.
Teleport to the level 35 obelisk using the obelisk network or a portable obelisk.
Use the Earth altar teleport, Varrock Teleport spell or the Edgeville lodestone, running through the Wilderness and using the southeastern entrance of the crater.
Use the Wilderness sword 4, teleport to the herb patch and run south.
Regardless of the method of travel, players opted into PvP may be attacked by player killers while in the Wilderness.

place.title: Wilderness Crater
place.summary: The crater is now home to many monsters, consisting of ankou, skeletons, hellhounds, greater demons, and lesser demons. The undead roam around the northern area of the crater, while the demons roam the southern area - hellhounds in the middle, lesser demons to the south-west and greater demons to the south-east. The entire crater is a multi-way combat area for the purposes of player versus player combat.

The bridge to Amberfell is initially out of commission, having fallen apart during flooding the previous season. A ranger stationed near the bridge warns that several travellers who headed east recently never returned. The trading caravans to Wendlewick have also not arrived for some time, as noted by Candle-maker Zeeva in Wendlewick who is originally from Amberfell.

Amberfell can be accessed after repairing the bridge south of Hollow Hill during the Secrets of Amberfell quest. After the village is visited for the first time, it can also be accessed via the fairy ring code DLP. Further, after repairing the canoe station with 6 maple planks and 20 steel nails, it can be accessed from any other station. [Chat: 4 Amberfell]

Amberfell is a small village on Havenhythe, situated on the edge of the moorlands and built around ancient ruins, with maple trees throughout. It is notable for its year-round falling leaves, which the locals attribute to a blessing from Inanna. Visitors consistently describe the inhabitants as kind and pleasant, and the village maintains regular trading links with Wendlewick via caravan. Amberfell also has a close relationship with the nearby village of Heathervein, its sister settlement, whose inhabitants work primarily as miners rather than loggers.

getting_there.text:
• Fairy ring code DLP
• Home teleport to Wendlewick Key press | Alt+W , then take a canoe Key press | 4 
• Travel to the Moonrise digsite, then head south
• Stonevein amulet Key press | Tree and go west.

getting_there.heading: Access
getting_there.text:
The bridge to Amberfell is initially out of commission, having fallen apart during flooding the previous season. A ranger stationed near the bridge warns that several travellers who headed east recently never returned. The trading caravans to Wendlewick have also not arrived for some time, as noted by Candle-maker Zeeva in Wendlewick who is originally from Amberfell.

Amberfell can be accessed after repairing the bridge south of Hollow Hill during the Secrets of Amberfell quest. After the village is visited for the first time, it can also be accessed via the fairy ring code DLP. Further, after repairing the canoe station with 6 maple planks and 20 steel nails, it can be accessed from any other station. [Chat: 4 Amberfell]

get_inside.text: Lunar Sea

Players with level 83 Farming can grow a Spirit tree on Etceteria and then use the spirit trees to teleport to and from the tree on the island. Players must have completed the Tree Gnome Village quest to teleport using spirit trees.
Fairy ring code CIP teleports the player north of the castle on Miscellania. Players must have progressed through part of the A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen quest to teleport using fairy rings.

Players with a ring of Wealth, ring of Fortune, or luck of the Dwarves can teleport directly to Miscellania, then walk across the bridge to Etceteria. Miscellania teleport is unlocked on the rings after completion of the Throne of Miscellania quest.

Players can travel between Rellekka and Miscellania (and then on to Etceteria) via boat, by talking to or right-clicking the nearby Sailor, who shall let you use the boat only if you have completed The Fremennik Trials quest. In Rellekka the boat is located at the docks just north of the marketplace. In Miscellania the boat is located at the dock on the south-eastern part of the island. When arriving at Miscellania, players wearing Fremennik sea boots 2 or better can jump from the north end of the dock onto Etceteria. This is considerably faster than walking north to the bridge connecting the two islands.

Players with level 30 Construction can move their Player-owned house to Rellekka for 10,000 coins. They can then simply use the House Teleport spell, leave the house, and then walk a short distance north to get the boat to Miscellania.
Using the Fremennik Province lodestone, which is east of Rellekka and north-east of its entrance. Players can teleport using the lodestone, then take the boat to Miscellania/Etceteria.

get_inside.text: South of Falador
The farm is in some ways the crossroads of Asgarnia. It has a convenient location, near Draynor Village, Falador, Port Sarim, and Rimmington. There are several ways to reach the farm.
The fastest way is to utilise the Cabbageport function of the Explorer's ring 3 or 4, as this will teleport the user to the cabbage patch belonging to the farm.
If players have their house in Rimmington, they can teleport to house and run to the farm.
If players have a spirit tree grown in Port Sarim, they can teleport there and run north.
Using the Captain's Log to teleport to Port Sarim and go north.
Teleport to the Port Sarim lodestone and run north, or the Draynor lodestone then run west.
If a player binds their amulet of nature to a patch in the farm, it will teleport the player to the patch when the crops are diseased or fully grown. As this isn't certain, it is rarely used.
Players can charter a ship to Port Sarim and run north.
Falador farm

place.title: Falador farm
place.summary: If that isn't enough, there is also a large pasture containing several cows, which will all drop raw beef, bones, and their prized cowhides. The meat can be cooked in Falador or on a fire to be used as food, the bones buried, and the cowhides tanned and used for Crafting, or sold on the Grand Exchange to others wishing to train Crafting for a fair price. If players don't wish to cook the meat for food, they can also eat the cabbages that spawn in the patch nearby.

The Feldip Hills are positioned to the south of Yanille and Kandarin and southeast of the Castle Wars arena. They are mostly populated by ogres. The capital of the Feldip Hills is the city of Gu'Tanoth; to the west of Gu'Tanoth is Jiggig. Jiggig is filled with Zogres and Skogres (zombie and skeleton ogres, respectively). In the southern areas is a Hunter training area. After completing the quest Big Chompy Bird Hunting, the hunting area can be used to hunt Chompies. In the south-east of the area is the city of Oo'glog. North-east of Oo'glog, the Monastery of Ascension can be found. Also note, to the west near the coast, north of the fishing spots, is a Death rune spawn. Despite the fact that this area is called Feldip Hills, its middle part consists of jungle and southern part consists of plains with many Eucalyptus trees.

There are two entrances to the dungeon. The most common is in Edgeville, in the ruins south of the bank. It is marked by a mark on the minimap.

Another entrance is west of the Cooks' Guild near Varrock on the east side of the River Lum. To get in, the player must bring a brass key which can be found in the dungeon. Alternatively, members can use the bank in the Cooking guild, which is nearer, provided they have completed the Hard set of the Varrock tasks.

The Wizards' Tower is a famous Saradominist institute of magic and runecrafting in Misthalin. The immense tower is located on a small island south of Draynor Village, connected to the mainland by an exquisite bridge.  The tower is associated with many other wizards outside the tower as well as the Wizards' Guild of Yanille, with which it has a sort of rivalry. The Wizards' Tower has two of the only known portals to the Runespan realm, home of the Runecrafting Guild. The current Wizards' Tower is sometimes known as the Second Wizards' Tower, as the First Wizards' Tower was burnt to the ground due to a magical explosion in the year 70 of the Fifth Age.

place.title: Troll Invasion
place.summary:
Troll Invasion is a members-only single-player Distraction and Diversion. The trolls are making a push to invade Burthorpe, and the Imperial Guard are being overwhelmed and require assistance. The trolls can be stopped through either combat or skilling.
monthly reset countdown 

Getting started

Speak to Captain Jute outside the newly constructed gatehouse north of the Warriors' Guild. He will offer you the choice of fighting the trolls or keeping the gatehouse repaired. Confirm that you've picked the one you want to do and you will start the D&D. You can start the game quickly by right-clicking and choosing either 'start-repairing' or 'start-fighting'. If you haven't yet done this D&D since the 1st of the current month, he will ask you if you're sure you've picked the right one as it resets the 1st of every month 0:00 UTC.

get_inside.text: At ground level, there are three entrances.
There is a jail entrance behind the Training Centre, which allows the player to access the jail. This is marked by the dungeon icon on the map and is the only entrance usable at first.

The main door into the Training Centre, which is locked, preventing players from opening it from the outside, until they talk to the Guard in the jail and go through the entire conversation about reporting rule-breakers. Once inside, going down the stairs leads players down to the same jail level.
A crevice immediately north of the centre, a shortcut into the dungeon that can only be used after climbing the rope from inside the dungeon at least once.

Inside the town is a POH portal, which can be reached with a House Teleport spell or tablet if your player-owned house is located in Yanille. If the Love Story quest has been completed, a yanille tablet (made from a chipped teleport to house tablet) can be used to teleport to the Yanille house portal, even if your house is located elsewhere.

place.summary:
or CLS))
map: Map | x=2577 | y=3091 | zoom=1 

Yanille is a members-only town that lies to the south of Ardougne. It is the town of the wizards and contains the exclusive Wizards' Guild. Yanille is beset by ogres from the south and west, and players find out during the Watchtower quest that this is the reason it is so heavily defended by guards.

get_inside.text: Baxtorian Lake
A player diving into the whirlpool.
pic: A player diving into the whirlpool.

get_inside.text: The whirlpool entrance to the Ancient Cavern is south of the Barbarian Outpost, at the head of the River Dougne, above Baxtorian Falls. Players can get there by walking west from Seers' Village, north from East Ardougne, or east from the Tree Gnome Stronghold. (From the Stronghold, players with level 37 Agility can take the shortcut northeast of the Grand Tree; otherwise, the more round-about route through the Stronghold's southern gate is necessary.)
Some teleports can be used to get near the whirlpool:
A games necklace can teleport to the Barbarian Outpost. This is quickest way to get to the whirlpool, as it is just south of the Outpost.
A combat bracelet can teleport to the Ranging Guild, which is east of Baxtorian Falls.
Barbarian Teleport from the Lunar Spellbook. Teleporting between the Barbarian Outpost and Lunar Isle provides quick banking during slayer tasks.
A plain of mud sphere can teleport one near the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
A skills necklace can teleport to the Fishing Guild, which is south-east of Baxtorian Falls.
Players with level 37 Agility can use the gnome gliders or spirit trees to travel to the Tree Gnome Stronghold and then use the shortcut north of the Grand Tree to get to the Baxtorian Falls lake.
Three teleports can be used to directly enter the dungeon:
Fairy ring code BJQ, which will teleport near the north-western most waterfiends, once it is repaired as described earlier.

The ferocious ring, which is a drop from the creatures in Kuradal's Dungeon, can teleport the player to Kuradal (Note: you can only attack the monsters in the dungeon if they are your current Slayer assignment assigned by Kuradal, Morvran, or Laniakea.)
The Slayer cape can be used to teleport the player to Kuradal.
Partial completion of AchievementIcon | Barbarian Firemaking

ml.name: The Shadow Reef
ml.text: Cooper is a miniboss in The Shadow Reef. He can be found on the first stage, by taking a path to the side that goes behind the entrance of the temple. He spawns near two item spawns of driftwood and a raw tiger shark. Like other barrelchests, his melee attacks will disable any active prayers a player is using, and drain prayer points at the same time. He can also use a special attack where he fires cannonballs into the sky, which will come down dealing cannonball damage onto the player.

ml.name: Sophanem Slayer Dungeon

get_inside.text: Sophanem
The dungeon is accessed via the dungeon entrance south of the temple of Icthlarin. It can be easily reached through the following methods:
The fastest method is to use a Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet. The ability to craft them is gained upon reaching rank 4 with any of the Menaphos factions.
Leela's favour provides unlimited teleports to the dungeon entrance.
The Mask of dust (or its transformed variant) can provide two free teleports to the entrance each day, assuming that the player has level 97 Slayer.
Use the Menaphos lodestone, go through the gate connecting the two cities, and run south-east. Using this method requires completion of Contact!.
Teleport to the Luminous wisp colony south of Sophanem via the full Elder divination outfit or a skill portal in the Max garden and head north.
Teleport to the Pyramid Plunder entrance in north Sophanem via the full Master camouflage outfit and head south.
Take a magic carpet flight to Sophanem. Upon arrival, run south and the enter the gate.
There are several access points to the magic carpet network, including:
Shantay Pass to southern Pollnivneach to Sophanem
Ring of slaying or the Slayer cape perk to Sumona in Pollnivneach and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.
Pollnivneach tablet and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.

Corruption beast.examine: A tainted creature of the corruption.

ml.name: Nomad's Temple
ml.text: Corruption beasts are found in Nomad's Temple during Nomad's Requiem. When a player kills one, their spirits are lifted and Prayer points are fully recharged.

place.title: Nomad's temple
place.summary: Nomad's temple is a vast, underground area under Soul Wars. The entrance to the temple can be found by investigating Nomad's tent during the Nomad's Requiem quest. The quest Nomad's Requiem largely takes place here. It is the home of Spectral attendants, Spectral cultivators, Spectral tenders, Spectral worshippers, Elemental creatures, Corruption beasts, and two of the highest-level quest monsters in the game: the Decaying avatar and Nomad himself. Once Nomad's Requiem is completed, there is no way to enter his temple again, until a brief section during Nomad's Elegy, where the player must investigate clues with Zimberfizz.

Cow.examine: Converts grass to beef. / You're sure you've seen herbivore. / Where beef comes from.
drops: [Only dropped by the cows on Astram Farm during the main Burthorpe path.]

place.title: Astram Farm
place.summary: A tree patch is found in the southern part of the farm, which will be tended to by Alain if he receives the correct payment. A potato patch is found to the north of it, which is tended to for free by Head Farmer Jones. This is the only potato patch in the game, and can be useful for low-level farming, as Jones hands out free potato seeds. Jones also owns a Farming Shop, which sells a number of low level seeds and basic farming supplies such as compost and plant pots.

get_inside.text: South-west of Falador
There are several methods of reaching the Crafting Guild. In addition to walking to the guild, players may use the following transportation methods:
A skills necklace or modified artisan's bandana can be used to teleport to the Crafting Guild.
Teleporting to the Port Sarim lodestone and running north-west.
Teleporting to the Rimmington player-owned house portal.
Members who have unlocked the Crafting Guild hot air balloon route after completing Enlightened Journey can take a hot air balloon to just north of the Crafting Guild for a fee of two charges.
While the guild itself does not stock sheep, there is a handy flock wandering free immediately to the north, just outside the Makeover Mage's house.

All players can use the bank deposit box in the guild itself. This turns into a bank chest upon the completion of the hard Falador achievements. Players retain access to the bank chest even after their membership expires.

get_inside.text: South of Falador
The farm is in some ways the crossroads of Asgarnia. It has a convenient location, near Draynor Village, Falador, Port Sarim, and Rimmington. There are several ways to reach the farm.
The fastest way is to utilise the Cabbageport function of the Explorer's ring 3 or 4, as this will teleport the user to the cabbage patch belonging to the farm.
If players have their house in Rimmington, they can teleport to house and run to the farm.
If players have a spirit tree grown in Port Sarim, they can teleport there and run north.
Using the Captain's Log to teleport to Port Sarim and go north.
Teleport to the Port Sarim lodestone and run north, or the Draynor lodestone then run west.
If a player binds their amulet of nature to a patch in the farm, it will teleport the player to the patch when the crops are diseased or fully grown. As this isn't certain, it is rarely used.
Players can charter a ship to Port Sarim and run north.
Falador farm

place.title: Falador farm
place.summary: If that isn't enough, there is also a large pasture containing several cows, which will all drop raw beef, bones, and their prized cowhides. The meat can be cooked in Falador or on a fire to be used as food, the bones buried, and the cowhides tanned and used for Crafting, or sold on the Grand Exchange to others wishing to train Crafting for a fair price. If players don't wish to cook the meat for food, they can also eat the cabbages that spawn in the patch nearby.

get_inside.text: Lumbridge Teleport - Unlike the lodestone, this requires level 31 Magic, a law rune, an earth rune, and three air runes but is faster and does not get interrupted by combat. Casting this spell is a medium Lumbridge achievement, Ease of Access.

Lumbridge teleport tablet - Members have the additional option of using teleport tablets to reach Lumbridge. This works similar to casting the Lumbridge Teleport spell normally but can be used when any spellbook is active and only takes up one inventory space.
Ring of respawn - Can teleport the player to the Lumbridge Castle courtyard.
Canoe - Provided the player has the Woodcutting level required, they may use the system to reach several locations, including Lumbridge.
A boat may be taken from the docks south of Taverley, which places players next to the Lumbridge Sage.

Portal Chamber - Players with at least level 50 Construction can build a Lumbridge Teleportation Portal in the Portal Chamber of their player-owned house. Building the portal requires 100 law runes, 300 air runes, and 100 earth runes.

Death - A method that requires little to no effort and no requirements, dying can send the player back to Lumbridge if they have not selected a different respawn point. Since Lumbridge is unlocked by default, this provides a way to get there with no skills or quests required. Players are, however, strongly recommended to bank any valuable items as they will only keep three (four with Protect item prayer on) items in case they do not reach their gravestone in time.

place.title: Lumbridge
place.summary: It is the first town that new players enter after completing the tutorial, and is home to various low level activities and quests. On the west side of the river the town has a general store, a fishing shop, a market with a bank and Thieving stalls as well as a smithy with a forge and an anvil and an entrance to the Thieves' Guild. The east side primarily features a large cow pen. The river itself has several Fishing spots. The southern part of the town houses a church with a graveyard and an entrance to the Lumbridge Catacombs and a passage to the Lumbridge Swamp. The city of Dorgesh-Kaan can be accessed from the castle's basement. West of the castle lies the Lumbridge forest.

place.title: Zanaris
place.summary: According to the co-ordinator, Zanaris is 'an extremely old place, it was here long before we fairyfolk came to live here' with many dormant magical properties, such as those of 'the ability to jump between planes using a powerful portal' that had been sealed for centuries, but the Fairy Queen harnessed the magic and used it to create the network of fairy rings, though not as powerful as the portal, the World Gate, would have been. This property of being a nexus of planes places it under threat from other realms. In the late Fifth Age, it was invaded by orks from Ork's Rift, but not without help of the malicious Fairy Mafia. Conversely, Zanaris is famous for its market, where various items from other worlds are sold, an example being a selection of dragon weapons from Freneskae supplied by the Consortium of Extra-Planar Merchandise Transferral Specialists.

ml.name: Uncharted Isles
ml.text: The Crassian scout is an attackable NPC that can be found randomly on Uncharted Isles. They may be killed for combat experience and chimes. While not aggressive, they are accurate and can hit hard if players are unprepared for combat. The scouts are usually found in large groups along with Crassian warriors, making it very dangerous to use area-of-effect attacks or abilities against them.

place.title: Uncharted Isles
place.summary: The Uncharted Isles are a procedurally generated island exploration system that offers member players the ability to discover new, unmapped islands in The Arc region. The islands are high-level skilling destinations for Fishing, Woodcutting, Divination, Farming, Hunter and Mining. Each new island has effectively randomly generated hotspots and points of interest. There is no guarantee that any given island will have a specific resource present.

ml.text: The crassian warrior is a monster that can be found randomly on Uncharted Isles. While not aggressive, they are accurate and can hit hard if players are unprepared for combat. The warriors are usually found in large groups along with Crassian scouts, making it very dangerous to use area-of-effect attacks or abilities against them.

place.title: Uncharted Isles
place.summary: The Uncharted Isles are a procedurally generated island exploration system that offers member players the ability to discover new, unmapped islands in The Arc region. The islands are high-level skilling destinations for Fishing, Woodcutting, Divination, Farming, Hunter and Mining. Each new island has effectively randomly generated hotspots and points of interest. There is no guarantee that any given island will have a specific resource present.

place.title: Slayer Tower
place.summary: As time passed, the other generals came to forget Viggora's Folly, but this only enticed Viggora to enlarge his fortress to earn their respect for humans. He planned to add more floors, make deeper dungeons and fortify the surrounding land. However, one day he returned to find the fortress had begun to sink into the swamp, as the ground had not been treated for such a massive project and that the dungeons were already flooding. This convinced Viggora that its nickname was well earned and that he was now completely humiliated.

place.title: Sophanem
place.summary: Sophanem was founded in the Second Age, shortly before the reign of Pharaoh Queen Senliten. It remained a relatively small village well into the Third Age, at which point the Kharidian Desert Campaign forced refugees from besieged settlements such as Uzer and Ullek to flee further south for survival. This re-location of most of the desert's populace essentially left Sophanem at the Menaphite nation's centre, eventually leading to its incorporation as part of a joint-capital with Menaphos.

ml.name: Sophanem Slayer Dungeon

get_inside.text: Sophanem
The dungeon is accessed via the dungeon entrance south of the temple of Icthlarin. It can be easily reached through the following methods:
The fastest method is to use a Sophanem Slayer Dungeon teleport tablet. The ability to craft them is gained upon reaching rank 4 with any of the Menaphos factions.
Leela's favour provides unlimited teleports to the dungeon entrance.
The Mask of dust (or its transformed variant) can provide two free teleports to the entrance each day, assuming that the player has level 97 Slayer.
Use the Menaphos lodestone, go through the gate connecting the two cities, and run south-east. Using this method requires completion of Contact!.
Teleport to the Luminous wisp colony south of Sophanem via the full Elder divination outfit or a skill portal in the Max garden and head north.
Teleport to the Pyramid Plunder entrance in north Sophanem via the full Master camouflage outfit and head south.
Take a magic carpet flight to Sophanem. Upon arrival, run south and the enter the gate.
There are several access points to the magic carpet network, including:
Shantay Pass to southern Pollnivneach to Sophanem
Ring of slaying or the Slayer cape perk to Sumona in Pollnivneach and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.
Pollnivneach tablet and then run south to southern Pollnivneach.

The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dangerous dungeon where armies of various gods, left over from the God Wars, fight one another to the death. Its release was announced in the Behind the Scenes of August 2007.

ml.name: Zarosian Empire
ml.text: It is likely Glacies, Umbra, Cruor and Fumus are extremely old, as they date back to the Zarosian Empire in the Second Age and fought in the God Wars in the Third Age, alongside Nex. According to Cruor, all of them have spent thousands of years in previous wars. It remains unknown how they maintain this unnatural lifespan for humans.

place.title: Zarosian Empire
place.summary: The empire was ruled by the god Zaros himself at the capital city of Senntisten which was located east of where Varrock stands today. Archaeological discoveries by the end of the Fifth Age spurred interest in Zarosian history and culture. The subsequent return of Zaros to Gielinor in the Sixth Age followed by research efforts forwarded by Dr Nabanik have led to the rediscovery of many long forgotten cultural elements.

get_inside.text: Asgarnia
The entrance to the courtyard.
Falador lodestone - Teleports near the north gate.
Falador Teleport - Teleports to the city square near the north gate. Requires level 37 Magic Magic and an air runes, a water rune, and a law rune. Falador teleport tablet may also be used.

Teleport to South Falador - Teleports to the south gate southern entrance. Unlocked at the Livid Farm, requires level 72 Magic Magic, being on the Lunar Spellbook and two astral runes, a law rune, and two air runes.
Skills necklace - Teleports to the Mining Guild's entrance.
Boss portal (War's Retreat) or Boss portal (Max Guild) attuned to the giant mole - Teleports to the Falador Park.
Ring of respawn - Teleports to the White Knights' Castle after completion of Recruitment Drive.
Skills necklace or balloon transport system - Teleport to the Crafting Guild south-west of the city, and climb into the underwall tunnel shortcut (requires level 26 Agility Agility).

Falador can be entered through the north gate, which has a road leading to Barbarian Village, and features a variety of guards; from the underground Dwarven Mine (either from the Mining Guild or from a house in the north-eastern neighbourhood of the city); through the south gate near Port Sarim; or by Falador Teleport, a spell which requires level 37 Magic (also requiring a water rune, three air runes, and a law rune). The north and south gates are popular training spots for low level players hoping to level up on guards.

Those with level 5 Agility can also enter from the west by using the Agility shortcut on the crumbling wall on the west side of the city. Members also can enter by crawling under a hole in the southern wall or by using a grapple shortcut to climb over the northern wall.
Grappling

A hidey-hole can be built for the 2-way grapple shortcut over the northern wall located where the shortcut is indicated on the minimap. The hidey-hole is a buildable storage spot to store a crossbow and grapple and eliminates the need to carry a crossbow and grapple to use the shortcut. To construct the hidey-hole, level 29 construction is required, as well as a saw and hammer (the tool belt works), four planks, a bronze crossbow, mithril grapple, and four nails. It requires level 11 Agility, 19 Ranged, and 37 Strength to use.

Falador (IPAc-en | ' | f | æ | l | ə | d | ɔːr Respell-en | FAL-ə-dor ) is the capital of Asgarnia. It serves as the base of operations for the White Knights and Temple Knights, two Saradominist knightly organisations. It has a significant role in the mining and smithing industries, with the south-eastern section of the city being home to both the Mining Guild and the Artisans' Workshop, and a mining dungeon under the eastern half of the city. Falador's population is usually around 40,000, although it swelled to almost 80,000 during the Siege of Falador.

ml.text: Cultists are Zamorakians that follow the megalomaniac demon summoner Denath. During Demon Slayer, after Denath steals a Tome of Demonology from the Edgeville Monastery, Gideon Bede, the caretaker of the library, chases after him. place.title: Edgeville Monastery
place.summary: In 164, the Edgeville Monastery was attacked by Lord Sulla, who had recently slain his predecessor and gained control of the organisation. The Battle of the Monastery was the first battle of the War of 164, and it saw the first use of Chaos Dwarf Mortars. The Edgeville Monastery's residents suffered heavy casualties in the battle, but the intervention of more well-equipped fighters such as Kara-Meir, Doric, Squire Theodore, Ebenezer, Castimir, and Gar'rth gave much of the order time to escape with Abbot Langley to the then-unincorporated city of Edgeville in Misthalin. The battle left the Monastery heavily damaged, but following the war it was rebuilt.

Varrock lodestone is located by the south gate.

Varrock Teleport or the teletab teleports to the main square. The destination can be changed to southern Grand Exchange entrance (requires Easy Varrock achievements) or north-east church (requires Elite Varrock achievements).
A Grand Exchange Teleport, ring of wealth, ring of fortune, or luck of the dwarves can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.

Varrock has four main gates, all of which are open to the public. Each is guarded by several level 36 guards, although they are not aggressive. The north gate can be found near the Wilderness wall and is commonly used by those travelling to Wilderness Crater or exploring the Wilderness. The east gate can be found after following the northern path at the crossroads near northern Al Kharid. The west gate can be reached by travelling east from Gunnarsgrunn. The south gate can be reached by travelling north-west from Lumbridge. Near it is the Stone Circle, where many level 7 and 20 dark wizards can be found.

There are also several other less-official entrances. By travelling north from the road east of the Gunnarsgrunn, players can enter the Grand Exchange, and from there the Varrock Palace grounds. An Agility shortcut north-west of the Grand Exchange can be used by members with 21 agility, running two-way between Varrock and Edgeville.

place.title: Varrock

It is the largest city for non-members and one of largest cities overall.

The God Wars Dungeon (often abbreviated as GWD), originally known as the Temple of Lost Ancients, is a dangerous dungeon where armies of various gods, left over from the God Wars, fight one another to the death. Its release was announced in the Behind the Scenes of August 2007.

getting_there.heading: Getting there
getting_there.text:
Prerequisites
• Navigating towards the dungeon requires having defeated Dad in the Troll Stronghold quest
• Entering the dungeon itself requires 60 Strength Boostable or 60 Agility Boostable 
• Entering each god encampment (therefore the boss rooms) has a skill requirement:
• Armadyl's Eyrie (south-west) - 70 Ranged Boostable | n 
• Bandos's Stronghold (north-west) - 70 Strength Boostable | n 
• Saradomin's Encampment (south-east) - 70 Agility Boostable | n 
• Zamorak's Fortress (north) - 70 Constitution Boostable | n 

Teleports
• Boss portal at War's Retreat - Requires killing any generals at least once and access to War's Retreat, and at least 100 total boss kills
• Combat portal at Max Guild - Requires Max Cape achievement and killing any generals at least once
• God Wars Dungeon Teleport - Requires level 61 Magic and completion of The Mighty Fall
• God wars teleport tablet - Requires completion of The Mighty Fall
• Trollheim Teleport - Standard spells, requires level 61 Magic and completion of Eadgar's Ruse
• Trollheim tablet - Requires completed Love Story and taken the miner's diary to the Wise Old Man
• Trollheim Farm Teleport - Lunar spells, requires level 92 Magic, completion of My Arm's Big Adventure, and unlock at Livid Farm rewards

Travelling from Fremennik Province

Checklist | * Teleport to the entrance to Fremennik Slayer Dungeon, for example fairy ring AJR, ring of slaying, Fremennik Province lodestone.
• Equip climbing boots to climb the rocks slightly north-east of the entrance (obtain the boots from Freda if the player does not have them).
• Enter the Troll Stronghold from Secret Entrance.
• Go to the upper level and exit the stronghold.
• Go to the north-east and follow the path. Be aware of the attacks from Thrower Trolls south of the boulder.
• Either lift the boulder (level 60 Strength) or squeeze past the boulder (level 60 Agility).
• Enter the hole near the knight.

Travelling from Burthorpe

Checklist | * Teleport to Burthorpe lodestone.
• Equip climbing boots (obtain them from Freda if the player does not have them). Also requires 41 Agility for cliffside.
• Follow the route to get to the dungeon. This route may take damage from Thrower Trolls around Death Plateau.
• Either lift the boulder (level 60 Strength) or squeeze past the boulder (level 60 Agility).
• Enter the hole near the knight.

ml.name: Warriors' Guild
ml.text: Cyclossi are monsters found inside the Warriors' Guild. They are much taller than a regular cyclops and drop the dragon defender and cyclopean helmet. There is a chance a cyclossus will be summoned when a player kills a regular cyclops, providing the player had shown a rune or dragon defender to Kamfreena before entering the room and wielded one whilst killing the cyclops. Unlike fighting the cyclops, either type of defender must be wielded while fighting Cyclossus; otherwise, the player will be prevented from doing any damage.

get_inside.text: Burthorpe
The Warriors' Guild is located in Burthorpe and can be accessed in a number of ways:
Burthorpe lodestone, which will teleport players directly east of the guild.
Combat bracelet, which will teleport players to a location directly outside the guild.
Games necklace, which will teleport players to Troll Invasion, just north of the guild.

place.title: Warriors' Guild
place.summary: Harrallak Menarous owns and operates the guild. The various members of the guild run activities, awarding points for participation. These points are used to gain temporary access to the combat room on the top floor, where cyclopes and cyclossi can be fought for defenders. The unofficial world for the Warriors' Guild is world 9.
